# Checkpoint

Task: Implement safe Punycode URL handling and improve URL extraction/error reporting in the link handler.

Starting point: Repository inspection is in progress. No source changes have been made yet.

Plan:
1. Locate repository instructions, URL helper, link handler, and their existing tests.
2. Implement hostname extraction, URL conversion, and external-link integration with an error notification for unextractable URLs.
3. Run relevant existing tests and record the outcome here.
EOF
find .. -name AGENTS.md -o -iname '*url*' -o -iname '*linkhandler*' -o -iname '*link*' | head -250"
